decisions.mark: explains that `skipSync: true` stops the single incoming reaction being treated as the post's complete set — without it every other reaction on the post would be deleted
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "In `sanitizeReactions`, this returns early with `deleteReactions: []`, so a single add event never deletes other reactions on the post. Without it, the function would diff the full DB set against the incoming list and mark anything missing for deletion." | WHY: The answer explains that skipSync stops the single incoming reaction from being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post. || QUOTE: "In `sanitizeReactions`, this returns early with `deleteReactions: []`, so a single add event never deletes other reactions on the post.
